syn: ip monitor [ all | OBJECT-LIST ] [ file FILENAME ] [ label ] [ all-nsid ] [ dev DEVICE ]

o.en: Prints timestamp before the event message on the separated line in format: Timestamp: <Day> <Month> <DD> <hh:mm:ss> <YYYY> <usecs> usec <EVENT>
Prints short timestamp before the event message on the same line in format: [<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>T<hh:mm:ss>.<ms>] <EVENT>
